quest.title: "Eye of Watatsumi"
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "...They say that Omikami's envoy had three eyes: one for the 'soul,' one a 'mirror,' and the last the 'truth'..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "...From the depths it arose, from the <color=#00E1FFFF>south</color>, o'er the <color=#00E1FFFF>north</color>, and all about the <color=#00E1FFFF>western</color> mound..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "...The three eyes shone mercilessly to ward off the dragon's heir..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon... knows all these words... but none of them mean anything when strung together.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It doesn't look like there are any clues around here either, so why don't we try using <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color>?

talks.objective: Read the stone tablet at the "Eye"
Break the seal over the shrine
